name: Global / international
summary: Identifiers that are not tied to one country. Truly reserved values exist for ISO 3166 user-assigned codes, ISO 4217 XTS, ICAO "Utopia" (UTO), GS1 prefix 952, SWIFT test-and-training BICs and the IETF/IANA documentation ranges (domains, IPv4/IPv6, AS numbers, MAC addresses). No reserved range exists for LEI, ISBN, ISSN, DOI, IMO numbers, ISO 6346 owner codes, VIN, IATA codes, ISO 6523 ICDs or E.164 country codes. Payment-card test numbers are published by the card schemes' acquiring/gateway businesses, not by ISO or EMVCo. Candidate container numbers (ZZZU/XXXU/QQQU), IMO 0000000 and VIN 11111111111111111 pass their check digits but were not checked against any register, so they are not listed. Note that Peppol / EN 16931 country code lists contain no user-assigned code except XI.

identifiers.name: LEI (Legal Entity Identifier)
identifiers.notes: No test LEI or reserved LOU prefix exists.

identifiers.name: GLN (Global Location Number)
identifiers.notes: Prefix 952 is reserved for demonstrations and examples (check gs1-952).

identifiers.name: GTIN
identifiers.format: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, GS1 mod-10 check digit

identifiers.name: SSCC
identifiers.format: 18 digits = extension digit + GS1 company prefix + serial + mod-10 check digit

identifiers.name: BIC
identifiers.format: 8 or 11 characters = 4 institution + 2 country + 2 location (+ 3 branch)
identifiers.notes: A '0' as 8th character marks a test-and-training BIC (check bic-test); '1' a passive participant.

identifiers.name: IBAN
identifiers.format: Country code + 2 check digits + national account (BBAN), up to 34 characters
identifiers.notes: An IBAN for a fictitious country is impossible, because validators check the country against the registry.

identifiers.name: Payment card number (PAN)
identifiers.notes: Mask it in realistic invoices (Peppol BIS keeps only the last 4–6 digits).

identifiers.name: Machine-readable zone (MRZ)
identifiers.format: TD1 3×30, TD2 2×36, TD3 2×44 characters; check digits with weights 7-3-1

identifiers.name: Container number
identifiers.format: 3-letter owner code + equipment category (U/J/Z) + 6-digit serial + check digit

identifiers.name: Peppol participant identifier
identifiers.notes: No test ICD or EAS code exists.
